tip_1: Breathe deeply: 4 seconds in, 4 seconds out. It brings your heart rate down.
tip_10: Short on time? 30–60 min before, something light: a banana or toast with honey.
tip_11: Coffee before training can help if it suits you; skip it late in the day if it keeps you awake.
tip_12: After training: 20–40 g of protein in the next hours — a shake, eggs, chicken, beans or Greek yogurt.
tip_13: A protein shake is handy, not required: normal food works just as well.
tip_14: Add carbs after training (rice, potatoes, pasta, fruit) to refill your energy.
tip_15: Sleep 7–9 hours: that is when your muscles actually recover.
tip_16: Have fruit or vegetables with every meal: they help you recover.
tip_2: Loosen your shoulders and shake out your arms. Stay on your feet if you can.
tip_3: Take a few sips of water, not half a litre in one go.
tip_4: Picture the next set: starting position, tempo, the last rep.
tip_5: Walk around a little: active rest helps you recover between sets.
tip_6: Look at your technique, not your phone: rest is part of the workout.
tip_7: Arrive hydrated: drink water through the day, not only at the gym.
tip_8: Sweating a lot or training over an hour? Add a pinch of salt or an electrolyte drink.
tip_9: Before training (1–3 h): carbs and some protein, like oats with yogurt or a turkey sandwich.
